# Coded Value

## Summary
A machine code plus the vocabulary it came from, so a stored value stays interpretable.

## Shape
`code` and `scheme` are stored; `label` is computed via `labelForCode`, which looks the pair up in
`METADATA_VOCABULARIES` and falls back to the raw code. An unrecognized vendor extension therefore
still renders as itself rather than disappearing.

The most reused field in the metadata family — six call sites: `CameraCapture.flash`,
`CameraCapture.orientation`, `GeoLocation.source`, `ColorProfile.colorSpace`,
`MediaEncoding.channelMode` and `MediaTags.scheme`. Known schemes: `exif-orientation`,
`exif-flash`, `geo-source`, `tag-scheme`, `channel-mode`, `color-space`.

## Example
```ts
import { CodedValueField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(CodedValueField);
```
